meta.variant: v2 rank-LUT CSR: per active group a C-bit class bitmap, a 64-class cumulative rank LUT (u32) and the support amount prefix (i64); B_g(i,j) = prefix[rank(j)] - prefix[rank(i)] with rank(c) = lut[c>>6] + popcount(bitmap[c>>6] & mask(c&63)); no per-query lower_bound
meta.note: one fresh process per run; every run writes the complete answer vector and its sha256; cold runs evict the fixture page cache with posix_fadvise(POSIX_FADV_DONTNEED) immediately before process start
